# Task Summary

Replace the current backend-based timeout configuration with a per-agent-role timeout system. Each agent role (implementer, QA, planner, etc.) should have its own configurable timeout value.

# Requirements

- Remove or deprecate backend-level timeout configuration
- Implement agent-role-based timeout configuration supporting:
  - `implementer`
  - `qa` 
  - `planner`
  - Any other agent roles in the system
- Set default timeout to 2 hours (7200 seconds) for all agent roles
- Timeouts should be configurable via `.ralph/ralph.toml` workspace config
- Apply the appropriate timeout when executing agent requests based on their role

# Implementation Constraints

- Build and test using Nix: `nix develop -c cargo check/test/build`
- Follow existing configuration patterns in `src/config/`
- Ensure timeout enforcement occurs in the workflow execution layer (`src/workflow/`)
- Backend execution in `src/backend/` should respect role-based timeouts

# Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Backend timeout configuration removed/deprecated
- [ ] New agent-role timeout configuration added to workspace config schema
- [ ] Default 2-hour timeout set for all agent roles
- [ ] Timeouts correctly applied during agent execution based on role
- [ ] Configuration can be customized per-role in `ralph.toml`
- [ ] Code compiles successfully with `nix develop -c cargo build`
- [ ] Existing functionality preserved (no regressions)
